fullContentHtml:
UPSC CDS-II Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Answer Key for Combined Defence Service CDS II posts. This recruitment was released for for 451 posts. The online application process for UPSC CDS-II Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 May 2026, to 11 June 2026. The examination was held on 13 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSC CDS-II Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • Check Exam Date Notice : Click Here
  • Check Date Extend Notice : Click Here

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
